name: Deadline
label: Deadline
description: A due date against now that turns from neutral to warning to error as it nears.

props.name: date
props.description: The moment it falls due: a Date, an ISO 8601 string or milliseconds since the epoch.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The IANA zone the time is shown in, named after it ("4:00 PM PST"), such as `America/Los_Angeles`. Without it the time shows in the reader's own zone.

props.name: display
props.description: `relative` writes the distance ("in 2 days"), `absolute` the date and time, `both` the two together. Defaults to `relative`.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: How close the deadline must be before it turns to the warning and then the error role.

props.name: prefixLabel
props.description: The word before the distance: "Due", "Closes", "Expires". Defaults to "Due".

props.name: overdueLabel
props.description: What a deadline that has passed says in place of the distance. Defaults to "Overdue".

props.name: variant
props.description: `badge` draws the Badge family's tinted pill; `text` writes it inline in the status text colour, for a sentence or a table cell.

props.name: tick
props.description: Rewrite the distance as time passes, pausing while the page is hidden. Defaults to true; off when `now` is set.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment to measure from, in place of the clock: for a server render that must match, a test, or a screenshot.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when the deadline moves to a new status as time passes, so a host can react (sort, notify).

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the distance and the date are written in. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.
